description: This file defines the ModelNotification class, which manages notification configurations and triggers notifications based on service events within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for building email contexts, resolving notification group configurations, and sending notifications.

classes.name: ModelNotification
classes.description: Represents a notification model that manages notification group configurations, constructs notification contexts, and triggers notifications based on service events within the Apache OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getNotificationGroupName
methods.description: Returns the notification group name associated with this notification.

methods.name: setNotificationGroupName
methods.description: Sets the notification group name for this notification.

methods.name: getNotificationEvent
methods.description: Returns the notification event that this object listens for.

methods.name: setNotificationEvent
methods.description: Sets the notification event that this object should respond to.

methods.name: callNotify
methods.description: Triggers notification if the event matches, executing the designated notification service.

methods.name: buildContext
methods.description: Constructs the context map for notification, including email details and related data.

methods.name: buildTo
methods.description: Constructs the 'to' email address string from notification group.

methods.name: buildCc
methods.description: Constructs the 'cc' email address string from notification group.

methods.name: buildBcc
methods.description: Constructs the 'bcc' email address string from notification group.

methods.name: buildFrom
methods.description: Constructs the 'from' email address string from notification group.

methods.name: getCommaSeparatedAddressList
methods.description: Helper method to get comma-separated email addresses for a specified notification type.

methods.name: getAddressesByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of email addresses of a specific notification type from a NotificationGroup.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Retrieves the subject for the notification from the NotificationGroup configuration.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Retrieves the screen URI for notification display from the NotificationGroup configuration.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns the service name used for sending notifications, currently fixed to 'sendMailFromScreen' if group is valid.

methods.name: getNotificationGroup
methods.description: Static method to retrieve a NotificationGroup by name from the service engine configuration.
